blocks.x: Most llm fine-tuning & model operations engagements stall between the deck and the deployment. Ours are built to cross that gap: Own your models — tune, distill and operate LLMs with measurable quality, controlled cost and enforceable policy.. What follows is the working pattern, not the brochure.

General-purpose models plateau on domain language: your claims vocabulary, your ICD coding practice, your credit memos. We run a disciplined adaptation program — instruction-tuning and preference optimization on curated enterprise corpora, distillation to right-sized models, and continuous evaluation against task-specific benchmarks — so the model that ships is measurably better on your work, not on a public leaderboard.

Model operations completes the loop: versioned model registries, canary deployment with automatic rollback, drift monitoring on live traffic, and a retraining trigger policy. LoRA and QLoRA pipelines on Databricks or dedicated GPU pools keep iteration cheap; every artifact is logged for model risk committees and EU AI Act technical documentation.

LLM Fine-Tuning & Model Operations delivery today concentrates in Banking & Financial Services, Insurance & Risk, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Manufacturing & Industrial. The metric is chosen with your finance lead, and the baseline is signed before any build begins.
What ships, in the order it ships:

domain data extraction, deduplication, PII scrubbing and rights management

SFT, DPO and RLHF variants with LoRA/QLoRA efficiency on managed GPU pools

frontier-teacher to 8B-13B student transfers that cut serving cost at equal task quality

task benchmarks, red-team suites and business-metric correlation studies
Model ops & registry
versioning, canary rollout, drift alarms and retraining triggers with full lineage
